'''Aran'gar''' can refer to two things:
* [[Dueling blades|Aran'gar (Dueling blades)]], one of a set of [[dueling blades]] dating from the [[Age of Legends]], used during the [[Collapse]] for a particularly vicious sort of knife-fight.
* [[Balthamel#His Resurrection and New Name|Aran'gar (Balthamel)]], the name of the [[reincarnation]] of Balthamel by the [[Dark One]].
